summary: Reads depth data from a Render TOP and outputs camera-depth imagery for shadow maps, depth effects, and precision workflows.

key_params.name: rendertop
key_params.note: Render TOP whose depth buffer is read

key_params.name: cameraindex
key_params.note: Camera index to read for multi-camera renders

key_params.name: depthspace
key_params.note: Depth space: input, cameraspace, or reranged

common_gotchas: A white-looking depth image may mean near/far planes are too loose, not that depth is missing.
Render TOP depth-buffer and camera-space settings affect the data Depth TOP can output.
Reranging through 8-bit formats destroys depth precision.
Multi-camera or depth-peel renders require the correct camera and peel layer index.
key_concepts: Depth TOP reads the depth buffer from a specified Render TOP.
Default visualization maps camera near plane toward black and far plane toward white.
Loose near/far planes can make the image appear white even when depth data exists.
Depth Space can preserve input depth, output camera-space depth, or rerange values.
Depth output is single-channel style data treated downstream as replicated depth with alpha.
Use 16-bit or 32-bit formats when depth precision matters.
